verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Canva serves a root llms.txt at canva.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes its developer documentation. Product-area llms.txt files also exist for SCIM, Admin API and audit logs, and individual doc pages are served as markdown (e.g. apps/mcp.md, apps/rest-apis.md), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and the root docs markdown path (/docs/.md) returns 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
